amphotericin b.t: Concurrent and/or sequential systemic, oral or topical use of other aminoglycosides, including paromomycin and other potentially nephrotoxic and/or neurotoxic drugs such as bacitracin, cisplatin, vancomycin, amphotericin B, polymyxin B, colistin and viomycin, should be avoided because the toxicity may be additive.

furosemide.t: The concurrent use of neomycin with potent diuretics such as ethacrynic acid or furosemide should be avoided, since certain diuretics by themselves may cause ototoxicity.

methotrexate.t: Oral neomycin inhibits the gastrointestinal absorption of penicillin V, oral vitamin B-12, methotrexate and 5-fluorouracil.

penicillin v.t: Oral neomycin inhibits the gastrointestinal absorption of penicillin V, oral vitamin B-12, methotrexate and 5-fluorouracil.

digoxin.t: Therefore, digoxin serum levels should be monitored.
The gastrointestinal absorption of digoxin also appears to be inhibited.

vitamin k.t: Oral neomycin sulfate may enhance the effect of coumarin in anticoagulants by decreasing vitamin K availability.

streptomycin.t: Aminoglycoside antibiotics cross the placenta and there have been several reports of total irreversible bilateral congenital deafness in children whose mothers received streptomycin during pregnancy.

anticoag.t: Oral neomycin sulfate may enhance the effect of coumarin in anticoagulants by decreasing vitamin K availability.
